statement.zh: Hargreaves ASI Memoir 35（1929）公布 1925 年马斯通萨姆普尔丘与纳尔·索尔达姆发掘，含纳尔彩陶。
statement.en: Hargreaves ASI Memoir 35 (1929) publishes 1925 excavations at Sampur Mound (Mastung) and Sohr Damb, Nāl, including Nāl painted pottery.
